name: heap_push

def heap_push(heap, item):
    def _siftdown(heap, startpos, pos):
        newitem = heap[pos]
        while pos > startpos:
            parentpos = pos - 1 >> 1
            parent = heap[parentpos]
            if newitem < parent:
                heap[pos] = parent
                pos = parentpos
                continue
            break
        heap[pos] = newitem
    heap.append(item)
    _siftdown(heap, 0, len(heap) - 1)
